description: This file defines the PaymentsProvider class, which manages payment processing state in a Flutter application. It uses ChangeNotifier for state management, providing methods to simulate a purchase process and clear purchase data.

classes.name: PaymentsProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages payment processing state, including initiating mock purchases and clearing receipts.

methods.name: purchaseMock
methods.description: Simulates a payment process by setting a processing state, waiting asynchronously, updating the receipt, and notifying listeners.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the last receipt and notifies listeners.
